theme.name: Light Theme (Swiss & High-Contrast)
theme.description: Authority, clarity, and truth. Objective, rigid, and function-first. Linear/Attio level of polish. A clean, data-dense interface tailored for back-office and energy consultants. Neutral grayscale base with precise, high-contrast structural borders. Accents are used exclusively for semantic meaning and alerts.

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/SaaS) - radical weight contrast. High density, extreme legibility.

fonts.heading: font-sans (Satoshi or General Sans via Google Fonts, fallback to system-ui)
fonts.mono: font-mono (JetBrains Mono) for CUPS numbers, Contracts IDs, and dates

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Control Room Grid Protocol. Density, Data Correlation, Scanability.

borders_and_radius.input_style: rounded-md border border-zinc-200 shadow-sm focus:border-zinc-900 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-zinc-900

customizations.cards: Avoid heavily styled cards. Use flat, rectangular, dense styles with 1px zinc-200 borders.
customizations.tables: Dense. Header rows with zinc-50 bg, very subtle borders. Use JetBrains mono for CUPS and numeric data.
customizations.badges: Flat background colors (e.g. emerald-50), no heavy shadows, small font sizes (text-[11px] uppercase).
customizations.kanban_board: Horizontal scrolling container. Columns (states) have a subtle gray background (bg-zinc-50), inner cards are pure white with 1px border. Drag indicator on hover.
customizations.ocr_upload_zone: Dashed border (border-zinc-300), bg-zinc-50 hover:bg-zinc-100 transition-colors, centered Lucide upload icon.

interaction_and_motion.hover_states: Crisp transitions. hover:bg-zinc-50 on list items. hover:-translate-y-[1px] on kanban cards.
interaction_and_motion.focus_states: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-zinc-900 focus:ring-offset-1 (accessible focus rings).
interaction_and_motion.motion: Minimalist. Framer motion only for layout transitions (like moving a kanban card) or opening modals.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.

pages_and_views.auth: Split screen layout. Left: Login form, very minimal. Right: The abstract 'light' generated background.
pages_and_views.dashboard_home: Executive view. Top KPI strip (Active Clients, Month Renewals, New Leads, Conversion Rate). Middle: Quick Alerts/Renovations. Bottom: Recent Pipeline changes.
pages_and_views.crm_pipeline: Kanban view. Top bar: Filters (commercial, date). Board: Columns for states (Nuevo Lead -> ... -> Cliente Activo).
pages_and_views.client_detail: Progressive disclosure. Header: Name, CUPS, Status. Tabs: Details, Contracts, Documents (Invoices/OCR), History.
pages_and_views.contracts: Data-dense table view. Sorted by upcoming renewal dates. Badges for priority/status.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard HTML+Tailwind for main layouts. Use Shadcn for complex interactives (Tables, Dialogs, Selects, Tabs).
Implement the Kanban board using a lightweight drag-and-drop library like @hello-pangea/dnd.
For the OCR extraction feature, build a clean drag-and-drop upload zone that shows an analyzing/loading state, simulating the Gemini 3 Pro OCR call.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use the provided avatar URLs for users/comerciales.
Implement a collapsible sidebar navigation with Lucide icons (LayoutDashboard, Users, FileText, Settings).
Ensure all buttons, inputs, and tabs have proper data-testid attributes.

To display the logo (which is a PDF), convert or use an iframe/object tag, OR rely on a stylized text logo 'AlgoMásQueLuz' using the Cabinet Grotesk/Satoshi font if the PDF cannot be rendered inline easily.
